description.en:
Walker S2 is UBTECH's industrial humanoid with autonomous battery exchange as a central operating feature. Its dual-battery system allows the robot to coordinate a replacement while maintaining power, using both arms to perform the exchange at a compatible station. The manufacturer reports a swap procedure of about three minutes.

Battery monitoring and task priorities inform whether the robot swaps or charges, supporting longer operating schedules when the necessary infrastructure is available. The platform also develops whole-body movement and manipulation for factory tasks. Continuous-operation claims depend on charged battery supply, station availability and the complete deployed workflow.
description.zh:
### 产品概述

Walker S2是优必选新一代工业人形机器人。自主热插拔双电池系统支持连续作业，高扭矩腰部、双目立体视觉和工业智能系统可满足复杂搬运与产线任务需求。

specs.label: Battery swap time
specs.conditions: Autonomous battery exchange using the manufacturer hot-swap system.

specs.label: Whole-body payload
specs.conditions: Manufacturer describes handling 15 kg through a 0–1.8 m working-height range; not per-arm payload.

sources.quote: 可在0-1.8米全空间范围内搬运15公斤重物。
